releases.name: Demon God Story
releases.summary: Demon God Story is an HD-2D action shooting game. In order to solve the expansion of corrupting particles in the Skeleton Demon Domain and the Skeleton God's ambition, the protagonist embarks on a journey of conquest.

releases.name: Witch Cabin Cleanup
releases.summary: Witch's Cabin Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 5,313 curios in a cluttered witch's cabin. Clean, learn spells, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

releases.name: Keep Her Safe
releases.summary:
Keep Her Safe is a survival shooting game. Gather resources, fortify your base, and withstand zombie hordes to keep the rocket project alive and bring an end to the acid rain apocalypse.

Besides the hard life in wasteland, you can also chill up with friends in different multiplayer gameplays.

releases.name: Overdue (Dry Fox Studio)
releases.summary: OVERDUE is a co-op multiplayer horror game for up to 6 players set in a massive shifting industrial warehouse where survival is based on productivity. Navigate through an anomalous industrial maze, manage your orders, and fulfill your mandate in time.

releases.name: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands
releases.summary: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands is a relaxing puzzle game where you must organize found futuristic loot in your backpack in a tidy way. Find unknown artifacts and learn details about the faraway lands... at least supposedly!

releases.name: For The Cat! Sorcerer's Revenge
releases.summary: They killed your cat. Fatal mistake. In this magic-infused bullet-heaven roguelike, develop your wizard, upgrade and evolve spells, collect items, and create unstoppable builds while battling hordes of enemies.

releases.name: Refund This Game
releases.summary: Fling yourself up to the top in this “Getting Over It”-like 3D platformer! Stick your pole to walls, bend it and fling yourself with great speed! One mistake means falling all the way down. Can you reach the summit in under 2 hours and EARN that refund?!

releases.name: Mushroom Marketplace
releases.summary: Run a whimsical mushroom café by day and explore a quiet village by night in this cozy tea-brewing roguelike!

releases.name: Nothing to Report
releases.summary: Explore winding subway tunnels as you seek to uncover forgotten memories in Nothing to Report, a survival horror adventure. Photograph encounters, identify threats and file reports on dangerous Lapses in real-time. One missed detail could cost you your life.
